title: Persist self-exec test child sweeps the shared user-temp product root instead of a repository-local test root
outcome: The persist test's self-executed child process uses the same repository-local temporary test root as its parent, so its startup sweep never touches the shared user-temp product root and cannot fail on entries other processes hold.
acceptance: The persist self-exec child (CASE_ENV branch) establishes the repository-local test temp scope before TestTempRoot::create, so its startup sweep runs only inside that scope.
All existing persist cases and assertions stay unchanged.
The root cause is recorded: the parent's thread-local temp scope does not cross the self-exec boundary, so the child defaulted to the user-temp product root.
